body.heading: Spread the evidence
paragraphs: Tip the clean socks onto a bed or table. Spread them out so you can see every clue.
Look at colours, stripes, and sizes. Detectives look before they grab.

body.heading: Match the pairs
paragraphs: Find two socks that match exactly and fold them into a pair. Put finished pairs in a neat row.
One lonely sock usually means its partner is hiding at the bottom. Check the basket twice.

takeaway: Every sock has a partner, and a good detective never gives up.
materials: A bed or table for sorting
safetyNotes: Only sort clean laundry, and let your adult check your detective work.
screenFreeExtension: Time your detective work: can you pair the whole basket before a song finishes?
